Graphs.reason: load-bearing Julia SimpleDiGraph, add_edge!, outdegree, ne, nv, and connectivity checks decide all checks
load-bearing Julia SimpleDiGraph, add_edge!, outdegree, ne, nv, and connectivity checks decide all checks

julia_command:
using Graphs
g = SimpleDiGraph(4)
add_edge!(g, 1, 2)
add_edge!(g, 2, 3)
add_edge!(g, 3, 1)
positive = nv(g) == 4 && ne(g) == 3 && outdegree(g, 1) == 1 && indegree(g, 1) == 1
negative = !is_connected(g)
add_edge!(g, 3, 4)
boundary = is_connected(g) && outdegree(g, 4) == 0
println("{\"positive\":" * string(positive) * ",\"negative\":" * string(negative) * ",\"boundary\":" * string(boundary) * ",\"nv\":" * string(nv(g)) * ",\"ne\":" * string(ne(g)) * "}")
